title: Origami boarding pass and tear-off stub
blurb: A live HTML boarding pass drawn on one 2D canvas as two sibling drawable sections. Fold it into four sheared origami panels, or drag across the dotted perforation to tear off the stub along a jagged edge while both halves stay clickable and editable.
question: Can a single live HTML boarding pass fold along scored origami creases and rip cleanly along a serrated perforation into two separate interactive pieces on a 2D canvas?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. The page draws two sibling drawable halves with five-argument and nine-argument drawElementImage(), restores hit regions after sliced draws with an empty-clip full draw, and runs six isolated checks in your browser.
